parts.html:
Every trade plants a tree.

Launch a coin on Treepad, pick a real tree, and every trade pays to plant it.

Pick your tree

Name your coin, add a ticker and an image, then pick a tree. 580 trees in 22 countries, from mangroves in Kenya to mahogany in Nicaragua.

Sign with your wallet and it goes live on pump.fun.

Where the fees go

80% of the creator fees plant your tree. 20% buys back and burns the Treepad coin.

The split is locked on chain at launch. Traders pay nothing extra: it all comes out of pump.fun’s normal creator fee.

Your coin grows a tree

Every coin gets its own pixel tree, and it grows with the market cap. A seed at launch, a sapling at $50k, a giant at $1M.

Tree-Nation puts the real ones in the ground. Every tree gets a public certificate, and every fee claim is a Solana transaction.

Your coin. Your tree.

Launch one on treepad.fun

Which tree are you picking? Tell me below.
